title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for c_p - c_v as R/M.

title: Physical Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student explains why c_p is greater than c_v, mentioning the work done during expansion at constant pressure.

title: Derivation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student includes key steps in deriving the relationship between c_p and c_v, such as using Maxwell's relation.

title: Ideal Gas Application
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly applies the ideal gas assumptions to derive c_p - c_v = R/M.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake or omits factors in the derivation of c_p - c_v.

title: Thermal Expansion and Compression
description: Optional Criteria: The student discusses the coefficients of thermal expansion and compression in relation to the specific heats.
